import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:http/testing.dart';
import 'package:luxo_client/luxo_client.dart' as sdk;
import 'package:test/test.dart';

import 'client.dart';
import 'types.dart';

part 'response_consumer.dart';
part 'json_kind_consumer.dart';
part 'json_projection_consumer.dart';
part 'stream_isolation_consumer.dart';

void main() {
  verifyScalarResponses();
  verifyJSONKinds();
  verifyJSONProjection();
  verifyStreamIsolation();
  final maximum = sdk.LuxoInt64.maxValue;
  final minimum = sdk.LuxoInt64.minValue;

  test(
    'every generated scalar API validates complete binary responses',
    () async {
      var response = Uint8List(0);
      final client = _binaryClient(() => response);
      addTearDown(client.close);
      final cases = <(Future<Object> Function(), List<int>, Object)>[
        (client.scalarInt, [0], sdk.LuxoInt64.zero),
        (client.scalarDuration, [0], sdk.LuxoInt64.zero),
        (client.scalarFloat, List.filled(8, 0), 0.0),
        (client.scalarString, [0], ''),
        (client.scalarBoolean, [0], false),
        (client.scalarDateTime, [0, 0], '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z'),
        (
          client.scalarUUID,
          List.filled(16, 0),
          '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
        ),
        (client.scalarBytes, [0], Uint8List(0)),
        (client.scalarDecimal, [1, 48], '0'),
        (client.scalarEnum, [4, 79, 80, 69, 78], 'OPEN'),
        (client.scalarJSON, [5, 102, 97, 108, 115, 101], false),
      ];
      for (final (call, bytes, expected) in cases) {
        response = Uint8List.fromList(bytes);
        expect(await call(), expected);
        for (final invalid in <List<int>>[
          [],
          [...bytes, 99],
        ]) {
          response = Uint8List.fromList(invalid);
          await expectLater(call(), throwsFormatException);
        }
      }
    },
  );

  test(
    'every generated scalar-array API validates complete binary responses',
    () async {
      var response = Uint8List(0);
      final client = _binaryClient(() => response);
      addTearDown(client.close);
      final calls = <Future<Object> Function()>[
        client.arrayInt,
        client.arrayDuration,
        client.arrayFloat,
        client.arrayString,
        client.arrayBoolean,
        client.arrayDateTime,
        client.arrayUUID,
        client.arrayBytes,
        client.arrayDecimal,
        client.arrayEnum,
        client.arrayJSON,
      ];
      final cells = _scalarArrayCells();
      final expected = <Object?>[..._scalarArrayJSON().values];
      expected[0] = [minimum, maximum];
      expected[1] = [minimum, maximum];
      expected[7] = [
        Uint8List(0),
        Uint8List.fromList([1, 255]),
      ];
      for (var index = 0; index < calls.length; index++) {
        response = cells[index];
        expect(await calls[index](), expected[index]);
        for (final invalid in <List<int>>[
          [],
          [1],
          [...cells[index], 99],
        ]) {
          response = Uint8List.fromList(invalid);
          await expectLater(calls[index](), throwsFormatException);
        }
      }
    },
  );

  test(
    'all generated scalar arrays agree across JSON, rows, columns and pages',
    () {
      final expected = _scalarArrayJSON();
      final input = ScalarArraysInput.fromJson(expected);
      expect(input.toJson(), expected);
      final row = sdk.LuxoEncoder();
      input.writeLuxo(row);
      expect(
        decodeScalarArrays(sdk.LuxoDecoder(row.bytes())).toJson(),
        expected,
      );
      expect(ScalarArrays.fromJson(expected).toJson(), expected);
      final columns = sdk.LuxoEncoder()
        ..writeVarint(1)
        ..writeVarint(0);
      final cells = _scalarArrayCells();
      for (var index = 0; index < cells.length; index++) {
        columns.writeVarint(index + 1);
        columns.writeBytes(cells[index]);
      }
      columns.writeEnd();
      expect(
        decodeColumnarScalarArrays(columns.bytes()).single.toJson(),
        expected,
      );
      columns.writeSvarint(maximum);
      columns.writeSvarint(sdk.LuxoInt64.fromInt(1));
      columns.writeSvarint(sdk.LuxoInt64.fromInt(1));
      final page = decodePaginatedScalarArrays(columns.bytes());
      expect(page.items.single.toJson(), expected);
      expect(page.total, maximum);
    },
  );

  test(
    'every generated scalar array rejects incomplete or trailing cell data',
    () {
      for (var field = 1; field <= 11; field++) {
        for (final payload in <List<int>>[
          [],
          [1],
          [0, 99],
          [2, 0],
        ]) {
          final encoder = sdk.LuxoEncoder()
            ..writeVarint(1)
            ..writeVarint(0)
            ..writeVarint(field)
            ..writeBytes(Uint8List.fromList(payload))
            ..writeEnd();
          expect(
            () => decodeColumnarScalarArrays(encoder.bytes()),
            throwsFormatException,
            reason: 'field $field, cell $payload',
          );
          expect(
            () => decodePaginatedScalarArrays(encoder.bytes()),
            throwsFormatException,
            reason: 'field $field, cell $payload',
          );
        }
      }
    },
  );

  test('JSON arrays retain null elements in inputs, rows, columns and calls', () async {
    final jsons = <Object?>[null, {'n': BigInt.parse('123456789012345678901234567890')}];
    final fields = _scalarArrayJSON()..['jsons'] = jsons;
    final input = ScalarArraysInput.fromJson(fields);
    expect(input.jsons, jsons);
    expect(input.toJson()['jsons'], jsons);
    expect(ScalarArrays.fromJson(fields).jsons.value, jsons);
    final row = sdk.LuxoEncoder();
    input.writeLuxo(row);
    expect(decodeScalarArrays(sdk.LuxoDecoder(row.bytes())).jsons.value, jsons);

    final cell = sdk.LuxoEncoder()..writeVarint(jsons.length);
    for (final item in jsons) {
      cell.writeBytes(utf8.encode(sdk.encodeLuxoJSON(item)));
    }
    final columns = sdk.LuxoEncoder()
      ..writeVarint(1)
      ..writeVarint(0)
      ..writeVarint(11)
      ..writeBytes(cell.bytes())
      ..writeEnd();
    expect(decodeColumnarScalarArrays(columns.bytes()).single.jsons.value, jsons);
    final transport = _ResponseTransport();
    final client = LuxoClient(transport);
    for (final response in <Object>[jsons, cell.bytes()]) {
      transport.response = response;
      expect(await client.arrayJSON(), jsons);
    }
  });

  test('generated scalar methods keep JSON tokens exact', () async {
    var response = '{"data":9223372036854775807}';
    var requestBody = '';
    final client = LuxoClient(
      sdk.HttpTransport(
        'http://example.test/luxo',
        client: MockClient((request) async {
          requestBody = request.body;
          return http.Response(response, 200);
        }),
      ),
    );
    addTearDown(client.close);
    expect(await client.echoInteger(value: maximum), maximum);
    expect(requestBody, contains('"value":9223372036854775807'));
    response = '{"data":[9223372036854775807,-9223372036854775808]}';
    expect(await client.listDurations(), [maximum, minimum]);
    response = '{"data":[1.0,1e20]}';
    expect(await client.listFloats(), [1.0, 1e20]);
    for (final invalid in ['1.0', '1e0', '9223372036854775808']) {
      response = '{"data":$invalid}';
      await expectLater(
        client.echoInteger(value: maximum),
        throwsFormatException,
      );
    }
  });

  test('generated binary scalar methods reject malformed responses', () async {
    var response = (sdk.LuxoEncoder()..writeSvarint(maximum)).bytes();
    final client = LuxoClient(
      sdk.HttpTransport(
        'http://example.test/luxo',
        options: const sdk.TransportOptions(mode: sdk.TransportMode.binary),
        client: MockClient((request) async {
          final decoder = sdk.LuxoDecoder(request.bodyBytes);
          expect(decoder.nextField(), isTrue);
          expect(decoder.fieldID, 13);
          expect(decoder.nextField(), isFalse); // Empty selection mask.
          expect(decoder.nextField(), isTrue);
          expect(decoder.readInt(), maximum);
          return http.Response.bytes(response, 200);
        }),
      ),
    );
    addTearDown(client.close);
    expect(await client.echoInteger(value: maximum), maximum);
    for (final invalid in <List<int>>[
      [],
      [128],
      [0, 0],
      [...List.filled(9, 255), 2],
    ]) {
      response = Uint8List.fromList(invalid);
      await expectLater(
        client.echoInteger(value: maximum),
        throwsFormatException,
      );
    }
  });

  test('generated structured inputs preserve every numeric shape', () {
    const wire =
        '{"id":9223372036854775807,"duration":-9223372036854775808,'
        '"values":[9223372036854775807,-9223372036854775808],"optional":null,'
        '"ratios":[1.0,1e20],"metadata":{"large":18446744073709551616,"fraction":1.0},'
        '"createdAt":"2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"}';
    final input = NumbersInput.fromJson(
      sdk.decodeLuxoJSON(wire, preserveNumberSyntax: true)
          as Map<String, dynamic>,
    );
    expect(input.id, maximum);
    expect(input.duration, minimum);
    expect(input.values, [maximum, minimum]);
    expect(NumbersInput.fromJson(input.toJson()).id, maximum);
    final encoder = sdk.LuxoEncoder();
    input.writeLuxo(encoder);
    final output = decodeNumbers(sdk.LuxoDecoder(encoder.bytes()));
    expect(output.id.value, maximum);
    expect(output.duration.value, minimum);
    expect(output.values.value, [maximum, minimum]);
    expect(output.optional.value, isNull);
    expect(output.ratios.value, [1.0, 1e20]);
    expect(sdk.encodeLuxoJSON(output.metadata.value),
        '{"large":18446744073709551616,"fraction":1.0}');
    expect(output.createdAt.value, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z');
    expect(sdk.encodeLuxoJSON(output), contains('"id":9223372036854775807'));
  });

  test(
    'generated columnar pagination keeps int64 totals and checks truncation',
    () {
      final encoder = sdk.LuxoEncoder()
        ..writeVarint(2)
        ..writeVarint(0);
      encoder.writeVarint(1);
      encoder.writeSvarint(maximum);
      encoder.writeSvarint(minimum);
      encoder.writeEnd();
      final column = decodeColumnarNumbers(encoder.bytes());
      expect(column.map((row) => row.id.value), [maximum, minimum]);
      encoder.writeSvarint(maximum);
      encoder.writeSvarint(sdk.LuxoInt64.fromInt(1));
      encoder.writeSvarint(sdk.LuxoInt64.fromInt(2));
      final page = decodePaginatedNumbers(encoder.bytes());
      expect(page.total, maximum);
      expect(page.page.toInt(), 1);
      final truncated = Uint8List.sublistView(
        encoder.bytes(),
        0,
        encoder.bytes().length - 1,
      );
      expect(() => decodePaginatedNumbers(truncated), throwsFormatException);
    },
  );

  test('generated lists reject metadata overflow', () {
    for (final count in [10_000_001, 4294967296]) {
      final encoder = sdk.LuxoEncoder()
        ..writeVarint(count)
        ..writeVarint(0)
        ..writeEnd();
      // Stop at the primitive error if the cap regresses; never allocate billions of rows in a red test.
      expect(sdk.ColumnarDecoder(encoder.bytes()).error, isNotNull);
      expect(
        () => decodeColumnarNumbers(encoder.bytes()),
        throwsFormatException,
      );
      expect(
        () => decodePaginatedNumbers(encoder.bytes()),
        throwsFormatException,
      );
    }
    for (final arena in [67_108_865, 4294967296]) {
      final encoder = sdk.LuxoEncoder()
        ..writeVarint(arena)
        ..writeEnd();
      expect(
        () => decodeNumbers(sdk.LuxoDecoder(encoder.bytes())),
        throwsFormatException,
      );
    }
  });

  test('generated lists reject malformed scalar array cells', () {
    for (final field in [3, 5]) {
      for (final payload in <List<int>>[
        [],
        [1],
        [0, 99],
      ]) {
        final encoder = sdk.LuxoEncoder()
          ..writeVarint(1)
          ..writeVarint(0)
          ..writeVarint(field)
          ..writeBytes(Uint8List.fromList(payload))
          ..writeEnd();
        expect(
          () => decodeColumnarNumbers(encoder.bytes()),
          throwsFormatException,
        );
        expect(
          () => decodePaginatedNumbers(encoder.bytes()),
          throwsFormatException,
        );
      }
    }
  });
}

const _uuid = '00112233-4455-6677-8899-aabbccddeeff';

LuxoClient _binaryClient(Uint8List Function() response) => LuxoClient(
  sdk.HttpTransport(
    'http://example.test/luxo',
    options: const sdk.TransportOptions(mode: sdk.TransportMode.binary),
    client: MockClient((request) async => http.Response.bytes(response(), 200)),
  ),
);

Map<String, dynamic> _scalarArrayJSON() => {
  'integers': [
    sdk.LuxoInt64.minValue.toBigInt(),
    sdk.LuxoInt64.maxValue.toBigInt(),
  ],
  'durations': [
    sdk.LuxoInt64.minValue.toBigInt(),
    sdk.LuxoInt64.maxValue.toBigInt(),
  ],
  'floats': [1.5, 2.0],
  'strings': ['', '\uFEFF\uFEFF发布\uFFFD'],
  'booleans': [false, true],
  'dates': ['1970-01-01T00:00:00Z', '1970-01-01T00:00:01Z'],
  'uuids': [_uuid, _uuid],
  'blobs': ['', 'Af8='],
  'decimals': ['0', '1.25'],
  'enums': ['OPEN', 'DONE'],
  'jsons': [
    false,
    {'large': BigInt.parse('18446744073709551616')},
  ],
};

List<Uint8List> _scalarArrayCells() {
  final writers = <void Function(sdk.LuxoEncoder)>[
    _writeIntegers,
    _writeIntegers,
    (e) => e
      ..writeFixed64(1.5)
      ..writeFixed64(2.0),
    (e) => e
      ..writeString('')
      ..writeString('\uFEFF\uFEFF发布\uFFFD'),
    (e) => e
      ..writeBool(false)
      ..writeBool(true),
    (e) => e
      ..writeDateTime('1970-01-01T00:00:00Z')
      ..writeDateTime('1970-01-01T00:00:01Z'),
    (e) => e
      ..writeUuid(_uuid)
      ..writeUuid(_uuid),
    (e) => e
      ..writeBytes(Uint8List(0))
      ..writeBytes(Uint8List.fromList([1, 255])),
    (e) => e
      ..writeString('0')
      ..writeString('1.25'),
    (e) => e
      ..writeString('OPEN')
      ..writeString('DONE'),
    (e) => e
      ..writeBytes(utf8.encode('false'))
      ..writeBytes(utf8.encode('{"large":18446744073709551616}')),
  ];
  return writers.map((write) {
    final encoder = sdk.LuxoEncoder()..writeVarint(2);
    write(encoder);
    return encoder.bytes();
  }).toList();
}

void _writeIntegers(sdk.LuxoEncoder encoder) {
  encoder.writeSvarint(sdk.LuxoInt64.minValue);
  encoder.writeSvarint(sdk.LuxoInt64.maxValue);
}
